rationale: Functional evidence passes filtering, numeric ordering, atomic invalid-status behavior, and exact banner integration. The command also protects task storage from destination collision, creates parents, emits stable summaries, and has broad focused tests. The atomic helper is well scoped and cleans temporary files, although its replace operation depends on the newer File.Move overload and the status comparison is case-sensitive without that choice being explained. The banner clearly communicates EXPORT in a compact framed panel, but nine deterministic art failures show that mixed-case text violates the required character set. It is more a status card than expressive ASCII art, with serviceable spacing but limited visual hierarchy. The added .gitattributes entry is relevant to preserving LF output, and the remainder of the diff stays focused.
